text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S lost the Nippon Derby. 
However, setting her sights on the next 
race, she quickly shifted her mindset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd expressed annoyance at her faint 
reaction. Zenno Rob Roy, on the other 
hand, saw her unshakeable demeanor even in 
defeat as the embodiment of the "hero" she 
ought to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her defeat, Tanino Gimlet drove 
the crowd wild with her running. Symboli 
Kris S feels that she herself could never 
generate that kind of frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet bids farewell, declaring the 
play has reached its end. Symboli Kris S 
is left struggling to grasp her true 
intentions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Symboli Kris S declared she 
would make use of today's defeat for the 
next race. Determined to stack up 
"results" next time, she made a fresh 
start.
